A1.justification: Both complete 21-page PDFs describe the same DiSE research, including Appendices A–E. Text comparison and rendering establish identical pages 3–21; the readable differences on pages 1–2 concern a project-page link and text reflow.

before.justification: v1 reports original likelihood-estimation, uncertainty-quantification, and flexible-length generation results in Tables 1–3, with further experiments and analyses in Appendices D–E.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons, appendix ablations, Dream-Instruct-7B evaluations, and token-distribution analyses.

M1.justification: The DiSE regeneration score in Equation 2, token-selection mechanism, and flexible-length generation procedure in Section 3.3 and Algorithm S1 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use ARC-Challenge, GPQA, Countdown, GSM8K, MATH500, and SVAMP for the same tasks. The natural-versus-randomized sentence and token-perturbation scenarios are also retained unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same Monte Carlo, autoregressive probability/perplexity, and fixed-length baselines. The DAEDAL comparison in Appendix D.5 and the Dream-Instruct-7B comparator sets are unchanged.

E3.justification: Models, generation lengths, Monte Carlo budgets, evaluation metrics, and five-answer sampling protocol remain unchanged. Appendix C.2 retains the same decoding settings and flexible-generation parameters.

E4.justification: The selection-mode and patience/mask-size ablations, qualitative correctness examples, and token-perturbation and distribution analyses are identical, including the supplementary evidence in Appendices D–E.

E5.justification: Run and sampling descriptions and statistical displays are unchanged, including Appendix E's distribution summaries and boxplots. No seed information, uncertainty-reporting practice, or significance-testing procedure is added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results in Tables 1–3, Tables S1–S7, and the figures are unchanged. For example, LLaDA-Instruct-8B DiSE retains 0.542/0.301 in Table 1 and average ROC-AUC 0.637 in Table 2.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and probability-estimation formulas, including Equations 1–2 and Appendix B's Equations S1–S3, are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's two contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about efficient regeneration-based self-evaluation and adaptive generation length. The project-page addition does not alter their scientific scope.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations of accuracy and efficiency remain identical. Both versions retain the limitations concerning unevaluated semi-autoregressive architectures and task-dependent selection of regeneration tokens.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page hyperlink at the end of the abstract, absent from v1. Implementation details in Appendix C are unchanged; the PDFs do not establish a new code or data release.

R1.justification: Section 5, the reference list, and the positioning relative to prior diffusion models and self-evaluation methods are unchanged. No cited research is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds the short 'Project page' statement and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose, terminology, section organization, and appendix structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added link causes local reflow on pages 1–2, moving the beginning of RQ1 onto page 2. Figures, tables, captions, and their placement are unchanged; pages 3–21 render identically.

improvement.justification: The project-page pointer provides a small navigation benefit, and RQ1 now stays together on page 2. These modest usability gains leave the scientific content, empirical support, and appendices unchanged; the PDFs do not establish additional code or data availability.
